none: PAS CAM-7E1D81: Copper-alloy Nummus Roman Coin of Crispus
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ CAESARVM NOSTRORVM ; D/ CRISPVS NOB CAES

Copper alloy Nummus of Crispus, 317-326. Rome ,321. Reece period 16. Reverse shows Laurel wreath with VOT/X within. Reverse legend reads CAESARVM NOSTRORVM. Obverse shows Laureate bust right. Obverse legend reads CRISPVS NOB CAES. Die axis is 12 o,clock. Weight 2.62g, diameter 18.98mm. RIC VII,p321, no 240
